items.title: The CVE flood
items.body: 49,675 CVEs were published in 2026. Total has passed 383,040 and keeps growing.

items.title: Critical ≠ exploited
items.body: Only 4.25% of Critical CVEs are actually exploited. CVSS severity is not an indicator of what attackers use.

items.title: Score disagreement
items.body: 18% of CVEs scored by both NVD and CNA have different base scores. Same vulnerability, different numbers.

items.title: Overrepresented scores
items.body: CVSS 9.8 appears far more often than the calculator would predict (25703:1 ratio). Researchers and hackers have strong preferences.

items.title: KEVs with no score
items.body: Exploited in the wild but no CVSS score. Companies can't prioritize these by CVSS alone.

items.title: Rejected CVEs
items.body: Duplicates, errors, and non-vulnerabilities that slipped through. Quality control is straining.
